options.name: image_version
options.description: Image/software version to be installed on the F5OS device.

options.name: partition_name
options.description: Partition Name for which ISO image version is to be installed or upgraded.

options.name: state
options.description: If C(install), starts the installation of the system image on the F5OS device. If C(present), checks for the status of the installation of the system image and waits for completion. If C(absent), presently this option is not supported.It will not remove the image from the device/uninstall the image.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The number of seconds to wait for software installation to complete. The accepted value range is between C(150) and C(3600) seconds.
